title: 100% line + branch test coverage across server and src
summary:
Achieved 100% line and branch coverage (Vitest + @vitest/coverage-v8) for every source file in the repo: server.js, src/main.js, src/audio.js, src/audio-codec.js, src/relay.js, src/util.js, src/player-worklet.js, src/capture-worklet.js. Total 304 tests pass (up from 280). Coverage report: All files 100% lines / 100% branches.

Key changes to reach the goal:
- main.js: added test-only exports (export block, __resetState, __setMyId, __setDefaultRelayUrl, __setIntentionalHangup, getStarveStart, getKeybindCapturing) with no runtime behavior change.
- Added exhaustive edge/branch tests covering: call signaling handlers (rejected/cancelled/rejected with no pending, mismatched callId), intentional-hangup quiet cleanup, ringtone auto-replay/stop, global keydown mute toggle on/off + toast branches, missing-incall-screen branch, btn-save-relay ws close paths, device-selects failure, keybind-display missing element.
- relay.js routing test now emits every server message type (registered, id-taken, accepted, rejected, cancelled, ended, peer-unavailable, reconnecting, reconnected, busy, muted, incoming).
- audio.js: no-micDeviceId, denoiser process/destroy error paths, resume error path.
- server.js: malformed (non-JSON) message handling, call with no display name, caller-rejects-clears-pendingOutgoing.
- player-worklet.js: mid-quantum underrun zero-fill, no-output-channel guard.
- Applied `/* v8 ignore next */` to genuinely-unreachable defensive branches per user decision: main.js ringtone-active dead return, ringtoneCtx null guards, handleRejected/handleBusy OR not-taken; server.js RELAY_TOKEN env default and the `node server.js` module-entry guard + 30s heartbeat callback (cannot fire in unit tests).
userVisibleChange: Test suite now reports 100% line and branch coverage across all 8 source files (server + src) with 304 passing tests. No application runtime behavior changed.

risks.title: v8-ignore comments add minor noise to production files
risks.mitigation: Only applied to clearly-unreachable defensive branches; each is documented inline with the reason it cannot be exercised in unit tests.

decisions.title: v8-ignore for defensive branches
decisions.rationale: User chose to mark unreachable/defensive branches (dead ringtone early-return, env defaults, module-entry guard, 30s heartbeat) with /* v8 ignore next */ rather than accept <100% branch or write contrived tests, to reach 100% coverage without changing runtime behavior.

decisions.title: Minimal test-only exports in main.js
decisions.rationale: Added __resetState/__setMyId/__setIntentionalHangup/etc. exports to expose private state for testing, matching the previously-approved non-breaking refactor approach. No app behavior change.

validation.output: 10 test files, 304 passed; All files 100% lines / 100% branches
